caption: The drawing depicts a single bonnet, which is a type of headwear. The bonnet is shown in a side profile and is primarily colored in dark shades of gray, almost black. The bonnet has a rounded, cylindrical shape with a structured, ridged texture that suggests it is made from straw or a similar material, and it wraps around the head. There is a wide, shiny, smooth fabric ribbon, also dark gray in color, that wraps around the crown of the bonnet and is gathered on one side into a large, loose bow. The underside of the bonnet is a lighter shade, and the interior is visible at the open front. The background of the drawing is plain and an off-white or cream color, without any other objects or features.
title: Straw Bonnet
